name: Commit & Execution Checkpoint Coordination
purpose: Bind a verified Git commit, authorization evidence and repair evidence into a deterministic execution checkpoint without executing or mutating canonical controller state.
allowed: bind repair evidence to commit evidence

deep_audit.01_purpose: Create a deterministic execution boundary after verified Git commit.
deep_audit.02_capability_completeness: Validate upstream evidence, bind commit and execution identity, create and verify immutable checkpoint.
deep_audit.03_inputs: T18 authorization, T20 verified repair, T21 verified Git transaction, repository and execution intent.
deep_audit.04_outputs: Immutable execution checkpoint and deterministic checkpoint result.
deep_audit.05_state_dependency: T03 and T12 state evidence is read-only and never mutated.
deep_audit.06_evidence_dependency: T18, T20 and T21 evidence must be internally consistent.
deep_audit.08_downstream_consumers: Execution orchestration, deployment, release and audit layers.
deep_audit.09_failure_modes: Commit mismatch, branch drift, authorization mismatch, repair mismatch, replay, invalid nonce and incomplete evidence.
deep_audit.10_security_boundary: T22 does not execute, authorize or promote authority.
deep_audit.11_determinism: Checkpoint identity is derived from canonicalized immutable evidence.
deep_audit.12_concurrency: Only one identical checkpoint identity may be active at a time.
deep_audit.13_recovery: Incomplete checkpoint creation fails closed; no destructive repository recovery is attempted.
deep_audit.14_gpt_limitation_coverage: Prevents stale context, wrong commit, duplicate execution and unsupported claims of execution readiness.
deep_audit.15_new_agent_usability: Machine-readable checkpoint request and result provide complete execution handoff context.
deep_audit.16_cross_chat_continuity: Checkpoint fingerprint and commit identity preserve continuity across chats and agents.
deep_audit.17_read_capability: Reads Git commit evidence, authorization, repair evidence and checkpoint registry.
deep_audit.18_write_capability: Only creation of immutable checkpoint evidence outside canonical controller state.
deep_audit.19_testability: Temporary deterministic evidence objects provide isolated tests.
deep_audit.20_observability: Checkpoint fingerprints, inputs, evidence identities and decision are exposed.
deep_audit.21_integration_contract: T21 verified commit becomes a T22 execution checkpoint.
deep_audit.22_missing_layers: Actual execution, deployment, release and production rollback remain downstream.
deep_audit.23_authority_permission_boundary: T22 cannot authorize itself or promote checkpoint authority.
deep_audit.24_idempotency_replay_safety: Checkpoint identity is deterministic and duplicate identities are rejected.
deep_audit.25_versioning_migration_compatibility: Schema, policy and checkpoint versions are explicit.
deep_audit.26_adversarial_red_team_coverage: Commit substitution, branch substitution, replay, nonce reuse, protected state mutation and self-authorization are blocked.
